posts.author: Yaoi
posts.body: I’m thinking of doing a horror fantasy game and I wanted to know if anyone can point me in the right direction to tutorials videos or websites or additional software that would help creating my own textures and tiles and my own custom sprites with their own custom animations any help would be appreciated

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Welcome!
Neither your profile nor your post gives any clue of what software you're using.
All the newer versions of RPG Maker have a tutorial built in, so that's an obvious starting place.
The instructions included with RPG Maker are also an obvious starting place - they describe the format of tilesheets, spritesheets, and any other kinds of files you could make to put in your own game.
And then, of course, there are YouTube videos, tutorials in this forum, tutorials on the blog linked to on the top of this page, everything that comes up when you Google a given topic...
Lots of people like to do this differently, but I would suggest you learn how to use whatever version of RPG Maker you have and make a game before you worry about all custom assets. All of that time spent drawing and tweaking and stuff doesn't matter if you don't have a game to play with it.
